atencion-ciudadana-digital.title: Humanika – Digital Citizen Services via Chat and Messaging
atencion-ciudadana-digital.description: Guide citizens through web chat and messaging. Humanika answers questions about services and procedures using information approved by your organization, and hands the conversation to an operator when a query needs human attention.
atencion-ciudadana-digital.cardLine: Web chat and messaging that guide procedures with approved information.
atencion-ciudadana-digital.useCase: Someone wants to know which documents they need to request a certificate. The agent explains the requirements and points them to the channel the organization has set up.
atencion-ciudadana-digital.imageAlt: A citizen checks her phone in a public space while the Humanika agent accompanies her and subtly points out the way to go.

seo.title: Chatbot for citizen services | Humanika
seo.description: Virtual assistant for public organizations: citizen services over messaging and web chat, with answers grounded in institutional sources and operator handoff.

telefonia-ia-bidireccional.title: Humanika – Two-Way Institutional AI Telephony
telefonia-ia-bidireccional.description: Take and make institutional calls with voice agents. On inbound calls, Humanika guides the caller and can transfer them to an operator. On outbound calls, it confirms appointments, delivers reminders and follows up on requests.
telefonia-ia-bidireccional.cardLine: Voice agents for your organization's inbound and outbound calls.
features: Transfer to operators based on the flow
telefonia-ia-bidireccional.useCase: An organization calls to confirm an appointment. Later, the person can call the institutional line to ask about their service and be transferred if they need further help.
telefonia-ia-bidireccional.imageAlt: A person on the phone next to an open planner; the Humanika agent appears as the other party in the conversation, close and attentive.

seo.title: Voice agents for citizen services | Humanika
seo.description: Inbound and outbound AI calls: confirm appointments, send reminders and transfer to operators. Institutional call automation with Humanika.

gestion-pqrsd.title: Humanika – Citizen Requests and Case Management (PQRSD)
gestion-pqrsd.description: Manage petitions, complaints, claims, suggestions and reports from intake to closure. Humanika helps file, classify and assign cases, and lets you check their status and associated deadlines.
gestion-pqrsd.cardLine: Filing, assignment and tracking of citizen requests through closure.
gestion-pqrsd.useCase: A city hall receives a complaint about the condition of a park. The case is filed, assigned to the responsible department, and the team can track it through to closure.
gestion-pqrsd.imageAlt: A public servant and the Humanika agent assist a citizen at a service desk; the scene conveys that someone is taking charge of her request.

seo.title: PQRSD management software | Humanika
seo.description: Citizen request filing, assignment by department, deadline alerts and request tracking with full traceability.

totems-con-avatar.title: Humanika – Self-Service Software for Avatar Kiosks
totems-con-avatar.description: Turn a self-service point into a guided service space. A Humanika avatar interacts by voice or touchscreen to guide procedures, help with forms and collect authorized data. The license covers the service point software.
totems-con-avatar.cardLine: An avatar that guides procedures by voice or screen at your sites.
features: Guided interaction by voice or screen
Form assistance and authorized data capture
totems-con-avatar.useCase: On arriving at a public office, a citizen talks with the agent to find the service she needs and learn the steps to follow before heading to the service desk.
totems-con-avatar.imageAlt: A citizen talks with the Humanika agent in the lobby of a public building, next to a kiosk blended into the space.

seo.title: Software for citizen service kiosks | Humanika
seo.description: Self-service kiosks with interactive avatars for public organizations: voice or screen guidance, form assistance and authorized data capture.

auditoria-de-atencion.title: Humanika – Service and Quality Auditing
auditoria-de-atencion.description: Review the quality of user interactions and spot opportunities to improve service. Humanika transcribes and analyzes authorized conversations, checks them against defined protocols and organizes findings into reports.
auditoria-de-atencion.cardLine: Interaction analysis against your service protocols.
auditoria-de-atencion.useCase: A service team reviews a sample of calls and finds that in several conversations the user hung up without knowing the next step. The team lead uses that finding to shape training.
auditoria-de-atencion.imageAlt: A supervisor listens to a conversation on headphones while the Humanika agent, beside her, helps her pause on a key moment of the interaction.

seo.title: AI service auditing | Humanika
seo.description: Call analysis and citizen service quality control: transcription, protocol evaluation and AI-generated findings reports.

copiloto-para-funcionarios.title: Humanika – Institutional Copilot for Public Servants
copiloto-para-funcionarios.description: Look up manuals, procedures and institutional regulations through a conversation. Humanika answers with references to approved sources and helps prepare summaries and drafts for the public servant to review.
copiloto-para-funcionarios.cardLine: Search internal manuals and rules with source references.
features: Summaries and drafts for human review
copiloto-para-funcionarios.useCase: A public servant asks which procedure applies to an internal request. The copilot finds the relevant section of the manual and prepares a summary she can verify before replying.
copiloto-para-funcionarios.imageAlt: A public servant and the Humanika agent talk beside a desk covered with documents, at the moment they find the reference they were looking for.

seo.title: AI copilot for public servants | Humanika
seo.description: Institutional knowledge assistant for searching internal regulations, manuals and procedures, with source references and reviewable drafts.

inteligencia-documental.title: Humanika – Institutional Document Intelligence
inteligencia-documental.description: Turn institutional documents into information your team can search and verify. Humanika classifies files, extracts fields and cross-checks data to make review traceable.
inteligencia-documental.cardLine: Document classification, extraction and cross-checking with traceability.
features: Search and validation with human review
inteligencia-documental.useCase: A team receives minutes and forms in different formats. Humanika identifies each document type, extracts dates and references, and leaves the results ready for the team to review.
inteligencia-documental.imageAlt: A professional reviews several documents at her desk while the Humanika agent helps her find the common thread between them.

seo.title: Intelligent document processing | Humanika
seo.description: AI document classification and PDF data extraction: turn minutes and forms into verifiable information, with cross-checking and human review.

validacion-de-tramites.title: Humanika – Smart Validation of Procedures and Case Files
validacion-de-tramites.description: Pre-validate case files before they go to review. Humanika reads the supporting documents, extracts information and checks it against requirements configured by your organization. The reviewer receives the missing items and inconsistencies found and decides how to proceed.
validacion-de-tramites.cardLine: Case file pre-validation against your organization's requirements.
features: Reading of requests and supporting documents
Detection of missing items and inconsistencies
validacion-de-tramites.useCase: Before reviewing a permit application, the reviewer receives a summary of the supporting documents found and an alert about a pending certificate. With that, they can review the file and guide the correction.
validacion-de-tramites.imageAlt: A reviewer and the Humanika agent go through a physical case file on a table together, at the moment they spot a missing piece.

seo.title: AI case file validation | Humanika
seo.description: Document requirement checks and review of requests and procedures: Humanika flags missing items and inconsistencies before review.

automatizacion-institucional.title: Humanika – AI Agents for Institutional Automation
automatizacion-institucional.description: Automate repetitive internal tasks with configurable flows. Humanika agents query authorized systems, carry out the defined steps and log what they did so the team can review the operation.
automatizacion-institucional.cardLine: Configurable flows that run tasks and log every step.
features: Queries and actions in authorized systems, depending on available integrations
automatizacion-institucional.useCase: When a request comes in, the agent looks up the available information, prepares the case and routes it to the person in charge, following the rules set by the organization.
automatizacion-institucional.imageAlt: A coordinator and the Humanika agent see a request through as it passes between two work areas, in a setting that suggests coordination and continuity.

seo.title: AI institutional process automation | Humanika
seo.description: AI agents for public organizations: automated workflows that query authorized systems, run tasks and keep a full audit trail.

asistente-de-contratacion-publica.title: Humanika – Public Procurement Assistant
asistente-de-contratacion-publica.description: Make it easier to review tender documents in the pre-contract stage. Humanika identifies requirements, cross-checks information and organizes findings into review matrices with source references.
asistente-de-contratacion-publica.cardLine: Tender review with verifiable requirement matrices.
features: Search across tender documents and annexes
asistente-de-contratacion-publica.useCase: A procurement team reviews a tender and its annexes. The assistant organizes the technical and documentary requirements and shows where each one appears so the team can validate the matrix.
asistente-de-contratacion-publica.imageAlt: Two professionals review a tender at a worktable while the Humanika agent joins the conversation and draws their attention to a specific document.

seo.title: Public procurement assistant | Humanika
seo.description: AI tender analysis: identify and cross-check requirements and build the procurement requirements matrix with verifiable references.

supervision-contractual.title: Humanika – Smart Contract Supervision
supervision-contractual.description: Track obligations, milestones and deliverables while a contract is carried out. Humanika organizes evidence and minutes, alerts you to upcoming deadlines and makes the supervisor's review easier.
supervision-contractual.cardLine: Tracking of contract obligations, milestones and deliverables.
features: Logging of obligations, milestones and deliverables
Assisted review of evidence and progress reports
supervision-contractual.useCase: Before a progress meeting, the supervisor checks which deliverables are about to fall due and what evidence has been received. With that, they prepare the review with the contractor.
supervision-contractual.imageAlt: A supervisor and the Humanika agent walk through a work site, exchanging observations in front of an activity in progress.

seo.title: Contract supervision software | Humanika
seo.description: Track contractual obligations, evidence and minutes, with contract deadline alerts and progress reports for the supervisor.

proyectos-e-inversion-publica.title: Humanika – Intelligence for Public Projects and Investment
proyectos-e-inversion-publica.description: Support the formulation and review of projects under Colombia's General Adjusted Methodology (MGA) and analyze the public investment portfolio. Humanika helps compare initiatives, identify similar projects and find uncovered goals, with references to the sources reviewed.
proyectos-e-inversion-publica.cardLine: MGA formulation and public investment portfolio analysis.
features: Formulation and document review of MGA projects
proyectos-e-inversion-publica.useCase: A planning department reviews its initiatives before prioritizing them. Humanika points out which ones have similar objectives and which development plan goals still have no associated projects.
proyectos-e-inversion-publica.imageAlt: A planning professional talks with the Humanika agent around a map of the region, weighing where to focus efforts.

seo.title: AI for MGA project formulation | Humanika
seo.description: Public investment analysis and regional project comparison: formulate and review MGA projects and spot uncovered goals with AI.

investigacion-y-consultas-publicas.title: Humanika – AI Research and Public Consultations
investigacion-y-consultas-publicas.description: Run interviews and surveys by voice or chat, document processes and analyze comments from public consultations. Humanika groups observations by topic or article and produces editable, traceable matrices so the team can prepare and review its responses.
investigacion-y-consultas-publicas.cardLine: Interviews, surveys and analysis of citizen comments.
features: Editable matrices of observations and responses
investigacion-y-consultas-publicas.useCase: After closing a consultation on a draft regulation, the team groups comments by article and identifies minority contributions. Each observation keeps its link to the original input to make review easier.
investigacion-y-consultas-publicas.imageAlt: At a community meeting, a person shares their perspective while the Humanika agent listens attentively.

seo.title: AI public consultation analysis | Humanika
seo.description: Traceable citizen observation matrices, thematic comment analysis, and AI-run interviews and surveys by voice or chat.

formacion-institucional.title: Humanika – AI Institutional Training Platform
formacion-institucional.description: Organize onboarding and ongoing training courses into learning paths. Participants have voice and chat tutors, and the training team can follow their progress.
formacion-institucional.cardLine: Onboarding and training paths with voice and chat tutors.
formacion-institucional.useCase: An organization welcomes new staff. Each person follows an onboarding path, asks the tutor questions and works through the content while HR reviews the group's progress.
formacion-institucional.imageAlt: A new team member talks with the Humanika agent at their workspace during their first days.

seo.title: AI institutional training platform | Humanika
seo.description: Onboarding and ongoing training software with virtual tutors over voice and chat, plus progress tracking for every participant.

simulacion-y-evaluacion.title: Humanika – AI Skills Simulation and Assessment
simulacion-y-evaluacion.description: Train skills in simulated scenarios by voice or chat. Humanika plays the role of the other party, assesses the practice with configurable rubrics and delivers feedback and performance reports.
simulacion-y-evaluacion.cardLine: Conversational practice assessed with configurable rubrics.
simulacion-y-evaluacion.useCase: A public servant practices handling an upset citizen. The agent plays the user and, at the end, gives feedback on listening, clarity and how the protocol was applied.
simulacion-y-evaluacion.imageAlt: A public servant rehearses a face-to-face conversation with the Humanika agent, which plays a person arriving with a difficult request.

seo.title: AI conversational simulation | Humanika
seo.description: Rubric-based assessment and citizen service practice in simulated voice or chat scenarios, with feedback and performance reports.

ensenanza-de-idiomas.title: Humanika – AI Language Learning
ensenanza-de-idiomas.description: Practice languages with AI tutors by voice and chat. Humanika suggests level-based paths and everyday and professional conversations, with guided activities and individual progress tracking.
ensenanza-de-idiomas.cardLine: AI tutors to practice languages by voice and chat.
ensenanza-de-idiomas.useCase: A student practices asking for directions in another language. The tutor keeps the conversation within the scenario and suggests activities that match her level.
ensenanza-de-idiomas.imageAlt: At a station, a student practices asking for directions with the Humanika agent as her conversation partner.

seo.title: AI language learning platform | Humanika
seo.description: Speaking practice with AI tutors and level-based language learning: guided voice and chat conversations with individual progress tracking.

analitica-de-espacios.title: Humanika – Space Analytics with Computer Vision
analitica-de-espacios.description: Understand how service spaces are used and which areas get the most visits. Humanika analyzes counts, occupancy, foot traffic and dwell time by zone and camera, and presents aggregated metrics in dashboards.
analitica-de-espacios.cardLine: Counts, occupancy and foot traffic by zone, in dashboards.
features: Foot traffic and dwell time analysis by zone
analitica-de-espacios.useCase: An office compares foot traffic in two service areas and identifies the hours when demand peaks. The team uses that information to better organize its service points.
analitica-de-espacios.imageAlt: From a raised vantage point, an operations manager and the Humanika agent watch people move through a public building.

seo.title: People counting with computer vision | Humanika
seo.description: Occupancy measurement and foot traffic and dwell time analytics by zone and camera, with aggregated dashboards and configurable alerts.

inspeccion-y-asistencia-visual.title: Humanika – AI Inspection and Visual Assistance
inspeccion-y-asistencia-visual.description: Document inspections from photos and field observations. Humanika helps describe evidence, log findings by voice or chat and prepare draft reports for review.
inspeccion-y-asistencia-visual.cardLine: Photo evidence and draft inspection reports from the field.
inspeccion-y-asistencia-visual.useCase: During a site visit, an inspector photographs a finding and dictates her observation. The agent helps her describe the evidence and prepare the draft visit report.
inspeccion-y-asistencia-visual.imageAlt: An inspector photographs a piece of infrastructure while the Humanika agent accompanies her in the field, both focused on the same detail.

seo.title: AI visual inspection | Humanika
seo.description: Photo evidence logging and assisted report generation: describe findings by voice or chat and prepare drafts for review.
